objective: Energetic German voiceover that leads the viewer through every reel and improves retention without sounding like a generic commercial.
writing_rules: Start speaking immediately; no greeting, no brand intro.
Hook must be spoken in the first 1.0 second.
Use short sentences and punch words.
One spoken idea per visual beat.
No filler phrases such as 'Viele Handwerksbetriebe haben das Problem'.
Prefer direct language: du/dein Betrieb/dein Büro.
Voiceover should usually fit 7–11 seconds for the current shortform format.
Keep on-screen text shorter than the spoken sentence; voice leads, text supports.
qa: No reel may publish with a generic stock voice.
Prefer the private Ibrahim clone for every public voiceover.
Hook must begin immediately and sound conversational, not announcer-like.
Pronunciation of Handwerk terms, numbers, Umlaute and Sleiman Systems must be clean.
Voice must be clearly louder than the sound bed.
No clipping, distortion, dead air or forced time-stretch that damages naturalness.
fallback_policy: Never use generic stock TTS for publishing.
If Ibrahim private voice is unavailable or generation would require paid credits not explicitly approved, publish no new voiceover version and keep the post blocked for voice QA.
A temporary stock voice may be used only for internal preview, never for scheduled public content.

06:45_warning.delivery: serious, energetic, direct, controlled warning tone
06:45_warning.pacing: short hard sentences with deliberate micro-pauses
06:45_warning.approved_example: Ich ruf später zurück? Genau hier gehen Anfragen verloren. Kein Status. Kein Verantwortlicher. Kein nächster Schritt. Dein Büro braucht ein System.
06:45_warning.rule: Use this profile as the default for the 06:45 Pain/Trust/Reach slot unless performance data or explicit user feedback justifies a controlled variant.
